tweets.text: And here's the top 100 for Masters https://t.co/Gx9FgmDarm

Traditional university rankings are a linearly weighted sum of attributes that shouldn’t matter (teacher to student ratio, graduation rate), or subjective metrics (reputation). Most incoming high school students care about one thing: will the best employers preferentially want to hire me? And this is what this list captures

To get an idea of how we capture what the “best employers” look like, PageRank style, here’s a sample. If a lot of people from Google leave to OpenAI, and people from OAI leave to Thinking Machines, they get ranked accordingly!
